# NewsLens project context
- Student project: daily news app using Times of India RSS feeds. No ads, no click tracking.
- Backend: Python 3.15, FastAPI, SQLite, feedparser, APScheduler, scikit-learn.
- Folders: APP/backend, APP/ml, APP/frontend, PanelPulse_ComicGenerator.
- Keep code simple, beginner-friendly, with short comments. No complex patterns.
- Never hardcode secrets. Use .env.
- Stories have: id, title, summary, link, source, published, importance_score.
- Be politically neutral. Credit TOI as the source.
